title: Update Stale Test Section Comments to Match Current Command Names
description: Update 6 section-header comments across 4 test files that still reference old deprecated command names. The tests themselves already exercise the canonical command classes — only the comment labels are wrong. This is Phase 4 of the remove-deprecated-commands-1 plan. A cosmetic-only change: no test logic changes, no assertions change.
prerequisiteState: Stories 37–39 are complete. No deprecated command classes, DeprecationHelper, or deprecated registrations remain in the codebase. dotnet test passes.
goal: After this story: all test section comments accurately describe the command under test using the current canonical command name. No comment in any test file references a deprecated command name.
scope: In tests/ZapiCli.Tests/UtilCommandTests.cs at the section divider around line 9: rename comment '// ── util time-ms ...' to '// ── util timestamp ...'. Preserve the trailing line-filler dashes to maintain visual alignment with adjacent section comments.
In tests/ZapiCli.Tests/UtilCommandTests.cs at the section divider around line 89: rename comment '// ── util time-now ...' to '// ── util now ...'. Preserve the trailing line-filler dashes.

In tests/ZapiCli.Tests/AccountCommandTests.cs at the section divider around line 225: rename comment '// ── account re-auth ...' to '// ── account refresh ...'. Preserve the trailing line-filler dashes.
In tests/ZapiCli.Tests/ScopeCommandTests.cs at the section divider around line 63: rename comment '// ── scope add ...' to '// ── account scope add ...'. Preserve the trailing line-filler dashes.
In tests/ZapiCli.Tests/ScopeCommandTests.cs at the section divider around line 215: rename comment '// ── scope list ...' to '// ── account scope list ...'. Preserve the trailing line-filler dashes.
In tests/ZapiCli.Tests/ApiRegistryTests.cs at the file-level XML summary comment (around line 10): change 'the <c>api registry</c> command group' to 'the <c>api endpoints</c> command group'.
Run 'dotnet test src/zapi-cli.sln' to confirm all tests still pass after the comment edits.
acceptanceCriteria: UtilCommandTests.cs contains no comment referencing 'util time-ms' or 'util time-now'
AccountCommandTests.cs contains no comment referencing 'account re-auth'
ScopeCommandTests.cs contains no comment referencing 'scope add' or 'scope list' (top-level, without 'account')
ApiRegistryTests.cs file summary references 'api endpoints' not 'api registry'
dotnet test src/zapi-cli.sln exits 0 with all tests passing
No test logic, assertion, or command class reference has changed — only comment text
contextForAgent: These are pure comment edits. The tests already instantiate the canonical command classes (UtilTimestampCommand, UtilNowCommand, AccountRefreshCommand, ScopeAddCommand, etc.) — this was done as part of the refactor stories (27–36). Only the section header comment strings need updating. Match the dash-filler width of adjacent section comments in the same file for consistency.
